growth_commentary: While Q3 was muted in terms of numbers, impending demand finally fructified into orders and reinvigorated focus on delivery.
Year-to-date order inflow added approximately INR440 crores to the order book, the highest quantum in a single year.
Order inflow in Q3 was broad-based with over INR102 crores through large opportunities and roughly INR115 crores through smaller orders.
Order book stood at approximately INR368 crores as of January.

pushback.question: How do private local partners act in state-level tenders, and who bears working capital and bank guarantees?
pushback.answer: Partners help in penetration and execution, sometimes acting as lead bidders, with payment terms largely within 30 days.

pushback.question: If an ideaForge drone has additional capabilities beyond base specs, must it still be the lowest bidder to win?
pushback.answer: Typically it is L1 only after technical evaluation, though defense capital procurement allows enhanced performance parameters for pricing advantages.

pushback.question: Will the business continue to have lumpiness, or is there more visibility compared to past years?
pushback.answer: Baseline activity and run rate business are growing and stepping up, though very large opportunities will continue to create some lumpiness when they arrive.
